Trim Level Breakdown XL: The entry-level work truck. XLT: The most popular consumer trim level. Whether you're hauling a week's worth of groceries or a full load of family and friends, this Explorer adapts to your situation. description: Why BUY from Mazda of Columbia?    When you choose this Black 2018 Mercedes-Benz E-Class E 300 with 81,758 miles, you are not just buying a used vehicle - you are investing in quality, reliability and peace of mind. Our clientele depend on us for Transparent Pricing, Convenience and, most importantly, Customer FIRST Service!          What this vehicle includes:    Burmester Surround Sound System ($850 value)        Safety and Security Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians.
